objective: Test whether the three historical New-York-local ICT Silver Bullet windows contain a repeatable after-cost sequence of frozen pre-window liquidity raid, completed reclaim and MSS, displacement FVG, decisive first retracement and delivery to opposing pre-window liquidity.

trader_explanation.bullish: During one of the fixed 03:00-04:00, 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-15:00 America/New_York hours, price raids frozen pre-window sell-side liquidity, reclaims it, then displaces through the last internal high and prints a bullish three-candle FVG. The first later interaction with the gap must accept the near edge or reclaim consequent encroachment. Entry is the next contiguous one-minute open, stop beyond the raid and target at frozen opposing buy-side liquidity.
trader_explanation.bearish: The exact mirror: buy-side raid, reclaim, bearish MSS/displacement FVG, decisive first retracement, next-open entry, stop beyond the raid and target at frozen sell-side liquidity.

historical_concept_sources.title: 2023 ICT Mentorship - ICT Silver Bullet Time Based Trading Model
historical_concept_sources.role: Defines the three New-York-local one-hour Silver Bullet clocks and the FVG-to-opposing-liquidity vocabulary. No reported performance is accepted.

distinction_from_prior_work: The expired broad session-range claim used Asian/London/New-York range acceptance and produced no branch, PR or result; this study uses three exact New-York-local one-hour entry clocks and an in-window FVG lifecycle.
Unicorn required failed order-block breaker conversion and breaker/FVG overlap; this study requires neither.
OTE uses a percentage retracement of an impulse rather than a fixed one-hour FVG clock.
FVG-SMT and SMT-sweep are paired-market models; this is single-symbol time-price delivery.
Quarter-hour order flow uses first-ten-second imbalance and fixed-horizon diagnostics; this uses structural exits and no elapsed-time liquidation.

market_and_data.development_download_condition: At least one frozen fit candidate passes every fit gate.
market_and_data.missing_data: Exact UTC one-minute grid; no forward fill, interpolation or compressed time. Pre-window and setup state require contiguous valid minutes. Post-entry source failure is terminal account loss rather than trade deletion.

causal_definition.pre_window_liquidity: High and low of the immediately preceding 60 or 120 valid one-minute bars, frozen at window start.
causal_definition.raid: Inside the selected Silver Bullet hour, wick trades strictly beyond one frozen boundary.
causal_definition.reclaim: The same raid bar or one of the next three completed bars closes back inside the raided boundary.
causal_definition.mss: A later completed displacement candle closes through the opposite internal level formed by the preceding five completed one-minute bars.
causal_definition.fvg: Classic same-direction three-candle gap created by the displacement candle; minimum gap size is ATR-normalized.
causal_definition.first_interaction: The first subsequent completed bar that intersects the FVG is decisive. It must close beyond the near edge or reclaim consequent encroachment according to the candidate. A failed or merely touched first interaction permanently invalidates the setup.
causal_definition.entry: Next contiguous one-minute open after the accepted first-interaction bar.
causal_definition.stop: Raid extreme plus or minus a frozen 0.05 ATR buffer.
causal_definition.target: Opposing frozen pre-window liquidity, required to satisfy candidate minimum structural reward/risk before entry.
causal_definition.post_entry_exit: Protective stop, opposing-liquidity target, completed FVG invalidation or source/stage failure only. Window-end and elapsed-time exits are prohibited.
causal_definition.ambiguity: Adverse actual open for stop gaps; protective stop before target when both touch in the same bar; target no better than its frozen level.

account_contract.growth_denominator: all UTC calendar days in each evaluation year

promotion_boundary.2024_open_condition: A development survivor still requires separate preregistration for exact Bybit BBO/depth, actual funding and sequential 2024 evaluation.

prohibitions: No outcome-driven change to windows, DST handling, liquidity horizon, reclaim delay, displacement, FVG, first-touch acceptance, stop, target, cost, risk or leverage.
No favorable same-bar ordering, touch-only fill or missing-minute compression.
No window-end or elapsed-time forced liquidation.
No 2024-2026 data access in this screen.
No credentials, paper, testnet or live orders.
